# shmuelie-authoring

Technical-authoring skills for RFC-style specifications and readability analysis.

```text
agency plugin install "market:shmuelie-authoring@https://github.com/shmuelie/shmuelie-skills" --engine copilot
```

## Skills

| Skill | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `ietf-rfc-authoring` | Produce RFC-style specifications with BCP 14 language and kramdown-rfc |
| `writing-level-analysis` | Measure Flesch-Kincaid and related readability metrics |
